items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: I had three chances to go with him... But it was already too late... I still would have liked to have gone with the band.

ctx.x: What happened to the audience for the music during - oh gosh, mid 50s I guess.

Well I guess it got to be concerts instead of dancing. The dancing is just starting to come back now, the last few years. But bands in the early days played for dancing. Even Duke and Basie and all them, I mean they played for dancing. But then it got to be concerts and the dances went another direction.
Do you think that was a good or bad thing?
